title: feat(spec): {current_iso_week} defaults a week-keyed filter to the current ISO week
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6v19uPsX6gX42G8tGcvvzb)_
Fixes #34938

Clause-②: yes (widening: the closed filter-placeholder vocabulary gains one token)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md (its "Date Macros" section lists the filter-placeholder vocabulary; it should name `{current_iso_week}` as a period key that is text, not a date)

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：看板的文本筛选可以把默认值设成「本周」，每次打开自动填入当前周号（如 2026-W47），筛选框里直接显示周号；写死的周号照旧可用。
- 为什么：按周号存数据的应用以前只能写死某一周，下周就过期；按您「加一个固定占位符」的裁定执行。
- 如果判断错：只影响用了这个占位符的筛选；跨年那几天周号若算错，看板会落到相邻的一周。误用在日期字段上会直接被拒绝并提示，不会悄悄给出错误结果。
- 需要您做的：无。

## What changes

- **Spec.** `PERIOD_KEY_TOKENS = ['current_iso_week']`, `isPeriodKeyToken` and `PERIOD_KEY_TOKEN_DESCRIPTIONS` in `data/date-macros.zod.ts`. It is a sibling list, not a member of `DATE_MACRO_TOKENS`, so `isDateMacroPlaceholder`, a date dashboard default and a calendar `initialDate` still refuse it. `classifyFilterToken` answers a new kind, `period-key`; `isKnownFilterToken` knows it. The dashboard `defaultValue` TSDoc and describe name the text-filter use.
- **Server.** `resolveFilterTokens` (`@objectstack/core`) resolves it with `bucketDateKey(now, 'week', ctx.timezone)`, the same label the analytics week bucket groups by: ISO-8601, Monday start, the ISO week-numbering year at the year edges, today in the workspace zone. The unknown-token message names it.
- **Client.** `resolvePeriodKeyTokens` (`@object-ui/core`) carries the same rule; the client cannot import `@objectstack/core`, so the two copies are held equal by one 16-row parity table that both sides run. `resolveFilterPlaceholders` and `resolveDashboardFilterDefs` call it, so a text (or any non-date) filter opens with the resolved key in the box; a `date` / `dateRange` default is left to its own normalizer and refused there as before.
- **Lint.** No logic change: `{current_iso_week}` is a known token, so `filter-token-unknown` no longer flags it. The rule's explanation said "exactly two vocabularies", which this change made false; it now lists the period keys.
- **Docs.** A new "Defaulting to the Current ISO Week" section in the dashboards guide (with a type-checked example); the analytics and plugin-view placeholder paragraphs name the token; the date-macros and dashboard reference pages and the `data` api-surface / export-origins shards are regenerated.

## Tests

All runs below were at `f3bf7beb08`; the only later commit, `fa840834a0`, edits the changeset text alone, and the families that read it were re-run there.

- New pins: the 16-row parity table (year edges 2020-12-31, 2021-01-03/04, 2024-12-30, 2025-12-29, 2026-12-31, 2027-01-01/03/04, and zone rows for Tokyo, New York, Los Angeles and Shanghai) in core `filter-tokens.test.ts` and in ui `date-macros.test.ts`; a sibling of the spec-parity test for `PERIOD_KEY_TOKENS`; the classify / known-token / near-spelling cases in spec; the dashboard schema (date filter refuses, text filter keeps both spellings and a literal key); the lint no-finding cases; the dashboard-filter seeding cases (text, untyped, `${…}`, select, zone, literal key, embedded text, a date filter left raw).
- Every test file that reads a touched symbol, per package: spec 10 files / 1046 tests, core 6 / 392, lint 7 / 334, objectql 8 / 222, service-analytics 6 / 326 (+20 skipped), service-automation 1 / 65, driver-memory 2 / 78, driver-sql 2 / 79 (+2 skipped), formula 1 / 52, platform-objects 1 / 18, app-showcase 1 / 3, ui (core, plugin-dashboard, plugin-designer, grid, list, view, react, console, app-shell) 28 / 437 (+6 skipped). All passed.
- Typecheck: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/lint` `typecheck` and `@object-ui/core` `type-check` (which compiles its tests) all exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **The temporal-comparand door, measured as asked.** The dispatch asked what the door answers when the token meets a date or datetime column. Measured with `engine.find` on the SQL driver (SQLite) and the in-memory driver, which answered the same; now pinned to 2026-11-19. It is **not refused and not read as a date: the key reaches the driver and is compared as text**. Before this change the same query answered `FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN` / 400.
  - `placed_on` (date) `$eq` gives `[]`, `$gte` gives `[]`, and `$lt` returns every row.
  - `opened_at` (datetime) answers the same; `opens_at` (time) `$gt` gives `[]`.
  - The literal `"2026-W47"` on the same columns is refused `INVALID_FILTER` / 400.

  The door steps around every placeholder as written, and after resolution it judges only `date-macro` kinds. The context tokens (`{current_user_id}` on a date column) already behave this way. Per the dispatch the door was not widened. The docs say to use the token only on fields that store week keys. The fix belongs in the core temporal-comparand step-around: judge period-key and context placeholders as written, and step around only date macros. It is reported to the seat to file.
- **compareTo.** A chart's previous-period series (the compare-to shift) does not shift a period key, so the comparison series filters the same week. Not measured in a UI; reported, not changed.
- **Placeholders only as the whole value.** The token resolves only as a whole value. `'week {current_iso_week}'` is left as written, like every other placeholder.
- **Lint does not read dashboard defaults.** Lint does not walk `globalFilters[].defaultValue`. A typo there, such as `{currentIsoWeek}`, surfaces only at query time, as `FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN` / 400.
- **Files outside the claim's surface.**
  - `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`: its text became false with this change.
  - `ui/packages/core/src/utils/filter-tokens.ts`: the client's sibling resolver.
  - `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` and `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`: the other filter-placeholder paragraphs.
  - No path under `skills/**` changed; no generator wrote there.

## Verification

- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 120 families) ran locally. 118 exited 0 and 2 are NOT MEASURED; the reconciliation reads `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 120 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 118 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED`.
  - `check:skill-examples` first refused with exit 3 because `@objectstack/client-react` had no dist. After building it, the gate exits 0: 346 examples type-check, including the new dashboards example.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. It needs every workspace package's dist, which is a whole-repo build, left to CI.
  - NOT MEASURED: `vitest run scripts/` (ui). 170 of 171 files passed. The one failure, `unit-registry-absence-collision`, was caused by an unbuilt `@objectstack/client`; after building it, that file passes 15/15.
- `check:generated` is green after `gen:api-surface`, `gen:export-origins` and `gen:docs`. ui `check:new-line-citations` reports 0 new citations, and `overlap-check` merges cleanly.
- CI runs the full lint farm and the full package suites.

## Fix round (contract review 7003932618)

Head `6b8fc7b563`. It supersedes the "temporal-comparand door" acceptance note above: the door now refuses the token on temporal columns.

- **S1, closed in this PR.** The core predicate `isUninterpretableTemporalComparand` no longer steps around a `period-key` placeholder; it judges it as written. `{current_iso_week}` is not a calendar day, an instant or a wall clock, so on a `date`, `datetime` or `time` column it now gets the same refusal as the literal `"2026-W47"`: `INVALID_FILTER` / 400, before any driver read.
  - The narrowest correct place is the core predicate, the one rule both callers ask. The engine door (`where`, per-aggregation filter and `having`) and the analytics raw-SQL decline therefore move together; `judgeResolvedToken` gains only a docblock clause.
  - The record validator's write door already refused every placeholder through its own `readable` gate, so its verdicts do not change.
  - Date macros, unknown placeholders and the context tokens are still stepped around. The context-token half stays with #35394.
- **Docs and changeset.** The dashboards guide, the changeset and the spec module doc now say the key is refused on a date, datetime or time field, and the date-macros reference page is regenerated. They used to say it was compared as text and gave the wrong answer.
- **N1.** The changeset now carries the sentence "A consumer that switches exhaustively on `kind` gets a compile error until it handles the new kind."
- **N2.** Dropped, as the seat instructed. `flow-value-slot-template.ts` is not touched.
- **N3.** The lint `filter-token-unknown` hints and the inline comment now name the week key `{current_iso_week}` and the three vocabularies. Both hint lines stay one line of at most 200 characters (186 and 176).

### Pins

- **Core predicate** (`temporal-comparand.test.ts`). The predicate refuses every `PERIOD_KEY_TOKENS` member in both spellings, plus the literal key, on all three kinds. As controls, `{current_week_start}`, `{today}`, `{30_days_ago}` and the unknown `{current_iso_wek}` are still stepped around.
- **Engine door, recording driver** (`engine-temporal-comparand-door.test.ts`).
  - Refused with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 and no driver read: `$eq` / `$lt` / `$gte` / `$gt`, implicit equality and an `$in` member, on `due_on` (date), `created_date` (datetime) and `opens_at` (time), in both spellings.
  - Positive controls in the same test: a text `$eq` and an implicit equality return the W47 row; a text `$contains` reaches the driver as `2026-W47`; `{current_week_start}` on a date column resolves to `2026-11-16` and returns the W47 row.
- **REST query door over SqlDriver** (`data-temporal-write-real-day-iso.test.ts`).
  - The SQLite cell always runs; the PostgreSQL cell is a named skip unless `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` is set.
  - On `placed_on`, `opened_at` and `slot`, `$eq` / `$lt` / `$gte` in both spellings answer 400 `INVALID_FILTER` naming the field, with no read of the object.
  - As controls, a text `$eq` and `$contains` return the W47 row, and `{current_week_start}` on the date field returns it too.
- **InMemoryDriver** has no live pin in this PR. A new test file that imports `@objectstack/driver-memory` needs a census ruling (`scripts/driver-memory-census.ledger.json`), which a dev does not make. The refusal sits in front of every driver, and the recording-driver pin asserts that no driver read happens. The pre-fix reading on InMemoryDriver matched SQLite.
